instructions: CCv3 is a Windows-first Claude Code harness. Many files exist as two copies (repo and ~/.claude, src and dist, settings.json and its template). Prefer findings about correctness, security and drift between the two copies over style.

rules.rule: A change to a hook in .claude/hooks/src/<name>.ts must include the rebuilt .claude/hooks/dist/<name>.mjs in the same PR.
A hook registration added to .claude/settings.json must also be added to .claude/settings.json.template, and the reverse.
Never add files under .claude/rules/. Rules live in .claude/rules-src/; a .claude/rules/ folder makes Claude Code load every rule twice.
